title: Layer token modal
description: Access token prompt for protected layer or terrain sources.

ui.overview: The Layer token modal appears when a protected layer or terrain source needs an access token. It keeps the token request tied to the source that needs it.

controls.label: Token field
controls.description: Accepts the access token for the selected layer or terrain source.

controls.label: Validate
controls.description: Checks the token and unlocks the source when it is valid.

controls.label: Cancel
controls.description: Closes the modal without saving a token.

notes: Use the token modal only for protected source access.
